信号待ちの10秒は、動画の10秒より長いのか

Ten seconds at a red light and ten seconds inside a favourite video are equal on a clock, but not necessarily in experience. フッサールのretention, primal impression, protentionを手がかりに、the present appears as a field carrying the just-past and leaning toward what comes next.
